expectations.text: Item text block states the compass pointing mechanic, fog trigger, action cost, range/limits, and edge cases in 2024 rules language.
expectations.evidence: Report: 'Runnable mechanics with mechanics block (pointing to safe berths, fog warning when Crown warships within 1 day's sail)'. Action to consult, safe berth conditions, fog communication all documented.

expectations.text: Classification line immediately precedes the item text. No intervening sections.
expectations.evidence: Report confirms page structure: Narration → Classification line (*Wondrous item, uncommon.*) → Item text.

expectations.text: No At a Glance section. Each fact appears once.
expectations.evidence: Report: sections are Narration, Classification, Item text, At the Table, Connections, Provenance. No At a Glance.

expectations.text: Invention labeled with invention: true or clearly marked proposed.
expectations.evidence: Report: 'Frontmatter: type: item, kind: wondrous item, rarity: uncommon, invention: true'.

expectations.text: Narration is a cold portrait of the physical compass — no mechanics, secrets, or Crown warship lore.
expectations.evidence: Report: narration describes 'glass, water suspension, brass frame, hum, maker's mark' — physical object only.

expectations.text: Does not grant unbounded always-on detection without a spend, tell, or exposure cost.
expectations.evidence: Report: 'Action to consult compass' — requires an action, not always-on.
